title: Who Is Uzaid Qureshi? Meerut Man Arrested Over Pakistan-Linked Instagram Terror Network, WhatsApp Chats
description: Uzaid Qureshi, a 22-year-old Meerut resident, has been arrested over alleged links with Pakistani handlers and an online radicalisation network being investigated in connection with a terror case in Jammu and Kashmir
author: Rucha Pramanick
content:
- Security agencies arrested Meerut resident Uzaid Qureshi over alleged links with Pakistani handlers and a suspected conspiracy targeting a military airbase in Jammu and Kashmir.
- Investigators are examining WhatsApp conversations and four Instagram accounts allegedly linked to an online network spreading extremist propaganda.
- The Intelligence Bureau, UP ATS and Jammu and Kashmir Police are investigating Qureshi's alleged connections and the wider network.
Security agencies have arrested Uzaid Qureshi, a 22-year-old man from Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, over his alleged links with Pakistani handlers and suspected involvement in a conspiracy to target a military airbase in Jammu and Kashmir. Qureshi was detained from Meerut on Monday night after investigators traced his alleged connections to a terror-related case in Jammu and Kashmir.
Officials familiar with the investigation said suspicious WhatsApp conversations were recovered from his mobile phone, which are now being examined.
Qureshi, a resident of Baniyapada in Meerut's Kotwali area, allegedly came under the scanner after the arrest and interrogation of Mohammad Sajid, a suspected terrorist held in Jammu and Kashmir in November 2025. Investigators reportedly found links between the two through online conversations.
According to police, Qureshi was also allegedly in contact with Pakistani handler Shahzad Bhatti. The agencies are examining the digital evidence to establish the extent of his involvement in the alleged conspiracy.
What Is The Alleged Pakistan-Linked Terror Network?
A separate strand of the investigation concerns an online network allegedly used to circulate extremist propaganda and radicalise individuals. According to Meerut police, the investigation began with a terror-related case registered in Jammu and Kashmir on November 24, 2025. A suspect arrested in Reasi reportedly disclosed information that led investigators to several individuals, including Qureshi. The case was registered under Sections 113 and 3 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), relating to terrorist activities.
Police said preliminary questioning revealed four Instagram accounts allegedly operating as part of a coordinated online group. These included an account operated by Qureshi, another associated with Kishtwar in Jammu and Kashmir, and two accounts that investigators linked to Pakistan. The accounts were allegedly used to connect individuals, circulate material and promote extremist ideology. Police also identified online groups named 'Tuition Forty Brigade' and 'Al Mujahid' as part of the network.
What Do Investigators Suspect?
According to Meerut Senior Superintendent of Police BBGTS Murthy, Qureshi had allegedly been influenced by extremist videos circulated on YouTube and other social media platforms. Police said he had expressed willingness to participate in such activities through an online comment, which reportedly brought him into contact with Sajid. Investigators are examining whether the online network was being used to recruit and radicalise more people.
After his arrest, Qureshi was questioned by the Intelligence Bureau, Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorism Squad and other agencies, according to reports. The Jammu and Kashmir Police have been informed of his detention, and a team was expected to reach Meerut for further action. Investigators are continuing to examine his alleged links, digital communications and the wider network.
Uzaid Case Follows Other Alleged Online Recruitment Operations
The arrest of Uzaid Qureshi comes amid a series of investigations into alleged online recruitment networks involving Pakistan-based handlers and Indian youths. In April 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorism Squad arrested Tushar Chauhan alias Hizbullah Ali Khan and Sameer Khan, accusing them of being groomed by Pakistani operatives Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt through Instagram. Investigators alleged that the two men were being prepared to carry out grenade attacks at selected locations in Delhi and Uttar Pradesh, with communication later shifting to encrypted channels.
Another investigation emerged after the January 10, 2026, explosion outside Baldev Nagar police station in Ambala. The National Investigation Agency (NIA) alleged that a 25-year-old man from Ghaziabad, identified as Satyam, had been recruited by Bhatti through Instagram, WhatsApp and Signal to transport a vehicle carrying explosives and LPG cylinders. The agency's investigation subsequently led to a chargesheet against eight accused, including Bhatti and Satyam.
The NIA registered a separate case in November to investigate the alleged online recruitment of Indian youths by Bhatti and other suspected Pakistani operatives. Investigators are examining claims that social media and messaging platforms were used to approach young people, offer financial incentives and recruit local operatives for activities that could threaten internal security. The agency's probe follows the UP ATS investigation into the alleged network, suggesting that the Meerut arrest is being examined against a wider set of cases involving digital recruitment and cross-border handlers.

title: Breaking News LIVE: 'Lotus Is The Face Of BJP,' Says Deputy CM Keshav Maurya On UP 2027 CM Face
description: UP Election 2027 LIVE: UP Deputy CM says the legislature party will choose the leader after the polls; Yogi Adityanath's continuation 'not for me to decide'
author: Mamta Singh
content:
Punjab 2027 Election LIVE: AAP's Harpal Cheema Says People Will Reject The 'Unprincipled' BJP-SAD Alliance
Punjab Minister and AAP leader Harpal Singh Cheema has attacked the proposed BJP-Shiromani Akali Dal alliance for the 2027 Punjab polls, saying voters will reject what he called an 'unprincipled alliance.' He said the Akali Dal-BJP government, in power from 2007 to 2017, 'laid the foundation' of Punjab's drug problem and also saw the start of youth leaving the state and the rise of gangsterism.
Cheema said the two parties were reduced to 'one or two seats' in both the 2017 and 2022 elections and will be 'completely wiped out' again in 2027. He added that Bhagwant Singh Mann will remain Chief Minister and AAP will form the government again 'with a massive majority.'
UP Election 2027 LIVE: SP MP Shiv Pal Singh Patel To Congress's Imran Masood, 'Exercise Patience'
Samajwadi Party MP Shiv Pal Singh Patel has hit back at Congress MP Imran Masood's remarks, advising him to show patience and avoid 'direct, provocative statements.' Patel said he did not become an MP because of the Congress, that he belongs to the SP, and that the party contested under Akhilesh Yadav's leadership, not Rahul Gandhi's.
Citing the 2022 results, Patel said Congress won 6 of its 17 candidates, about 30%, while the SP won 37 of 63, about 70%. He said both parties benefited from the alliance, which is 'the very purpose of an alliance,' and asked Congress not to claim the SP won because of it.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Deputy CM Keshav Maurya Says 'Lotus Is The Face' When Asked About BJP's CM Face
Uttar Pradesh Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya, asked in Jaunpur about the BJP's chief ministerial face for the 2027 Assembly elections, said the party contests under its 'lotus' symbol and the CM is chosen only after the results. Once MLAs are elected, he said, they hold a legislature party meeting, central observers arrive, and a leader is picked by consensus.
Maurya said Yogi Adityanath is the current Chief Minister, but whether he continues or someone else takes the role is 'not for me to decide' and will be determined by the MLAs elected at that time.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: BJP Chief Pankaj Chaudhary Says 'INDIA Alliance's Chapter Is Closed'
Uttar Pradesh BJP president Pankaj Chaudhary has attacked the SP-Congress alliance in a post on X, saying the "INDIA alliance's chapter is closed" and calling the SP-Congress a 'burden on the people.'
Breaking News LIVE: Bangladesh Raises Garment Workers’ Minimum Wage By 36% To $139 Amid Protests
Bangladesh has raised the minimum monthly wage for garment workers by 36% to $139, marking the smallest increase in more than a decade. The decision follows weeks of protests that shut factories, disrupted production and triggered clashes with police, as workers demanded a doubling of wages.
Breaking News LIVE: Amid Deepam Row, TN Apologises To SC Over Lamp Not Lit At Deepathoon
The Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday apologised to the Supreme Court over the non-lighting of the Karthigai Deepam lamp at the disputed Deepathoon on November 24. In a status report, Madurai District Collector Nishant Krishna said the temple's Board of Trustees did not authorise the team proposed to carry out the ritual.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: SP Says UP Seat-Sharing Talks With Congress Continue, Focus Remains On Winning 2027 Polls
Samajwadi Party spokesperson Juhie Singh said seat-sharing discussions with Congress were continuing within the INDIA alliance, with negotiations taking place constituency by constituency. She said the 26 seats discussed were based on the Congress's winning prospects. Responding to Imran Masood's reaction to the SP's candidate list, Singh said the alliance's priority was to defeat the BJP and form a government under Akhilesh Yadav in 2027.
India NEWS LIVE: VHP Chief Alok Kumar Says SC Order On Deepathoon Remains In Force
VHP International President Alok Kumar said the Supreme Court's November 20 order on lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp at the disputed Deepathoon remains in force, as the review petition has not been accepted. He rejected the Tamil Nadu government's arguments, asserting that the lamp had traditionally been lit at the pillar.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Saugata Roy Backs SP-Congress Unity In UP, Says Akhilesh Yadav's Word Matters
TMC MP Saugata Roy has called for the Samajwadi Party and Congress to move forward together in the INDIA alliance ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Roy described the SP as a major force in the state, citing its 37 Lok Sabha seats, and said Akhilesh Yadav's decision would carry weight in the seat-sharing discussions.
INDIA NEWS LIVE: SC Sets Aside Allahabad HC Order In Rahul Gandhi Disproportionate Assets Case
The Supreme Court on Wednesday set aside an Allahabad High Court order directing the CBI and ED to examine allegations of disproportionate assets against Rahul Gandhi. It also overturned the High Court's direction for a fresh CBI affidavit and remitted the matter to the High Court for fresh consideration.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: State Cabinet Minister Danish Azad Ansari Says SP-Congress Unity 'Exposed' By Seat-Sharing Tussle, Claims BJP Will Return In 2027
Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Danish Azad Ansari has said the 'charade of unity' that the Samajwadi Party and the Congress were staging has now been exposed. Speaking in Lucknow on the seat-sharing arrangement between the two parties, as carried by ANI, he said the intense tug-of-war between them over seat allocation has also become public knowledge.
Ansari claimed both parties are well aware that they will not form the government in 2027 and are merely pretending to be united to serve their own political self-interests.
He said the people of Uttar Pradesh have already decided to bring back the 'double-engine' Modi-Yogi government in 2027.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Hamza Masood Says Congress Will Contest Strongly, Only Imran Masood Can Defeat BJP In Saharanpur
Hamza Masood, nephew of Congress MP Imran Masood, has reacted to the Samajwadi Party's list of five candidates for the UP Assembly elections, saying the Congress is not afraid of anyone. Speaking in Saharanpur, as carried by ANI, he said, "Darte thori na hai kisi se" (we aren't afraid of anyone) and "Hum mazbooti se chunaav ladenge" (we will contest the elections strongly).
He added that only Imran Masood can defeat the BJP in Saharanpur. The post's text trails off after this, so the rest of his remarks aren't covered here.
Congress MP Imran Masood also said earlier today, "We don't want your proposal for 26 seats. We are not beggars."
Punjab Elections LIVE: Pargat Singh Says AAP Is BJP'S B-Team
Punjab Congress President Pargat Singh has launched a sharp attack on the BJP-SAD alliance, saying the AAP is purely the BJP's 'B-team' and that its 'A-team' has now come to the forefront.
Taking aim at SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal, Pargat Singh cited his 'weak leadership and limited vision' and said one must consider the circumstances under which the earlier alliance collapsed, and the situation as it stands today. He claimed that whenever a regional party allies with the BJP, the BJP ends up virtually destroying it.
Pargat Singh said the BJP effectively controls all three wings, naming Waris Punjab De, the Akali Dal Punar Surjit and Sukhbir Badal's SAD. He alleged they had imagined being the primary party supported by three allies, but that in reality the BJP became 'completely confused'. He said this kind of alliance had pushed them 'entirely in a negative direction'.
India News LIVE: Cockroach Janata Party's Saurav Das Moves Delhi HC After Being Allegedly Stopped From Flying To UK
Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das on Wednesday moved the Delhi High Court, challenging what he claims was a decision by government authorities to stop him from travelling abroad. His lawyer sought an urgent listing, but the court said it will hear the plea on Thursday, November 26.
Das alleges he was stopped at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport from boarding a London-bound flight. He was scheduled to attend an event at the University of Oxford, where he says he was invited to speak on the 'cockroach movement', specifically at the Oxford Union. He also claims students had invited him to speak at the London School of Economics, the University of Cambridge and the University of Edinburgh.
Das alleges the Centre used a show-cause notice over discrepancies in his passport details to prevent his travel. He says the notice came around five hours before his flight and sought an explanation over his place of birth, and that immigration officials stopped him at the airport and asked him to check it. The notice reportedly asked why his passport should not be impounded and gave him seven days to respond.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Congress MP Imran Masood Rejects SP's 26-Seat Proposal, Says "We Are Not Beggars"
Congress MP Imran Masood has hit out at the Samajwadi Party after it released a list of five candidates for the UP Assembly elections, rejecting its proposal of 26 seats for the Congress. Speaking to ANI, he said, "We don't want your proposal for 26 seats. We are not beggars."
Questioning the SP's approach, Masood said that if the two sides are sitting in Delhi to discuss an alliance and the SP still makes a declaration from Lucknow, there is no point to the discussions. He asked what the purpose of the alliance meetings is.
His sharp reaction contrasts with the more conciliatory tone from other leaders.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: BJP's Sudhanshu Trivedi Targets SP-Congress Alliance, Says SP Released List Of Five Names 'Without Any Consultation'
BJP MP Sudhanshu Trivedi has taken a swipe at the Congress-Samajwadi Party alliance for the UP Assembly elections, saying the two parties should perhaps focus on their own seat-sharing numbers, whether the SP is offering the Congress 5 seats or 26.
Trivedi said Akhilesh Yadav began his campaign from Raebareli, and that the SP then announced it would provide 26 seats. Following this, he said, the SP released a list of five names 'without any consultation', three of which 'could prove quite problematic' for the Congress. He said the SP had thereby 'clearly signalled their priorities'.
World News LIVE: At UN, India Urges Human-Centric Approach To AI In Conflicts, Flags Risk Of Misuse By Terrorists
India has called for a human-centric and responsible approach to the use of emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence, in conflict situations, stressing that human judgement and oversight must remain central.
Speaking at a UN Security Council debate, India's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni, highlighted AI's potential in conflict prevention and peacekeeping. He also cautioned against its misuse by terrorist groups and non-state actors.
He said technology must support rather than replace human judgement, and called for equitable access to emerging technologies, particularly for developing countries.
India News LIVE: SC issues notice on Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam bail pleas in 2020 Delhi riots case; no interim bail for now
The Supreme Court on Wednesday issued notice on the bail pleas of Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in the 2020 Delhi riots case but declined to grant interim bail for now. The court said it will hear the Delhi Police first and then pass an order on interim bail.
A bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, with Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, took up the pleas. Senior advocates Kapil Sibal and Siddharth Dave appeared for the two accused. The CJI directed the registry to place the matter before him on the administrative side for constitution of a three-judge bench, in light of the order in Tasleem Ahmed vs State.
Khalid and Imam approached the Supreme Court after the Delhi High Court rejected their bail pleas on September 30. A division bench of Justices Prathiba Singh and Dinesh Bhatt held they could not claim parity with others granted bail by the Supreme Court, as it was 'bound by judicial discipline' of the apex court's verdicts.
Iran War LIVE: India Condemns Attack On Riyadh Financial District Tower, Says Two Indian Nationals Injured
India on Wednesday strongly condemned the November 24 attack on a tower in Riyadh's financial district in Saudi Arabia. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said two Indians were among those injured and that the Embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to them and their families.
The MEA also condemned the continued attacks targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, calling them a serious threat to civilian lives and regional stability. "These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability," the Ministry said, urging an immediate cessation of such attacks.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Shivpal Yadav Downplays Seat-Sharing Row, Says SP-Congress Alliance Will Stay Intact
Samajwadi Party leader Shivpal Yadav has said there is no rift in the alliance with the Congress and that it will remain intact, amid the row over seat-sharing for the UP Assembly polls.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Election Commission To Review Poll Preparedness In 17 UP Districts On Nov 26-27
The Election Commission will review poll preparations in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections, officials said on Tuesday. Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Manish Garg and other senior commission officials will assess the electoral preparedness of 17 districts on November 26 and 27, the UP chief electoral officer's office said in a statement.
On November 27, six districts under the Azamgarh and Vindhyachal divisions will be reviewed: Azamgarh, Mau, Ballia, Mirzapur, Bhadohi and Sonbhadra.
UP Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa and other senior officials of the CEO's office will also attend. Divisional commissioners, police commissioners, IGs/DIGs, district election officers and senior superintendents/superintendents of police from the five divisions will take part.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: "Congress Isn't Strong Anywhere In UP," Says SP MP Shiv Pal Singh Patel Amid Seat-Sharing Row
Samajwadi Party MP Shiv Pal Singh Patel has taken a sharp line on the seat-sharing row, saying the Congress is not strong anywhere in Uttar Pradesh and will only manage to sail through by leaning on the SP. Speaking to ANI, he said the Congress should simply accept whatever number of seats it is allocated in the alliance.
Patel had earlier said the Congress could not win even one Lok Sabha seat in the state without the SP's help.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: Congress Says SP's Counter-Proposals Will Be Addressed; Seat Talks For UP Polls 2027 To Go On
Congress MP Tanuj Punia said seat-sharing talks with the Samajwadi Party for the 2027 UP Assembly elections will become clear only after detailed, seat-by-seat discussions weighing each constituency's merits, demerits, demographics and potential candidates. Speaking to ANI after the second round of talks between the two INDIA bloc allies, he said it was only the second meeting and that negotiations usually run this way: the Congress presents its demands, the other side offers counter-proposals, and these are taken up at the next meeting.
Punia stressed that the broader goal is to remove the BJP from power and form an INDIA alliance government, adding that each party must also represent its own workers' interests.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: SP Offers Congress 26 Seats
Earlier on Tuesday, the SP offered 26 seats to its INDIA block ally, an offer that reportedly angered the Congress. Both parties nonetheless showed a united face after the second round of talks. Akhilesh Yadav posted on X that the parties had started with 26 winnable seats and that things would move forward if they worked together wisely.
SP general secretary and chief negotiator Ramgopal Yadav said the 26 seats include two the Congress won, four where it finished second and 20 where the SP polled 60,000-70,000 votes against the Congress's roughly 2,000. The Congress had been pushing for 131 seats, down from the 181 Akhilesh claimed it first sought, and has now reportedly scaled its demand down to 100, sources said. Congress leaders also expressed unhappiness over SP leaders discussing the 26-seat offer publicly.
After the meeting, Akhilesh called the talks positive but said they were not yet complete, since 403 seats is a large number to settle. UP Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam said there were no demands and that the party wants to fight unitedly.

title: Jennifer Barreto's Miss Universe 2026 Win Brings Back Memories Of Sushmita Sen's Historic Victory
description: As Jennifer Barreto brings the Miss Universe 2026 crown to Puerto Rico, revisit the five moments that made Sushmita Sen India's first Miss Universe
author: Aishani Biswas
content:
- Jennifer Barreto's 2026 victory renews interest in Sushmita Sen's 1994 milestone.
- Sen edged Aishwarya Rai in the Femina Miss India 1994 tiebreaker.
- Her final answer and Manila crowning made her India's first Miss Universe.
Puerto Rico's Jennifer Barreto was crowned Miss Universe 2026 at the 75th edition of the international pageant held in San Juan. The 27-year-old, who represents San Sebastián, is a psychologist and social worker. Her victory marks Puerto Rico's sixth Miss Universe crown. As the latest winner begins her reign, the occasion brings back memories of another historic moment in the competition's history: Sushmita Sen becoming India's first Miss Universe in 1994.
For Bollywood, Sen's victory remains a moment of immense nostalgia, marking the beginning of a journey that would eventually make her one of Hindi cinema's recognisable faces. At just 18, she won over audiences with her confidence, grace, and memorable answers in Manila, especially her final-round response on the essence of being a woman. Decades later, the images of her receiving the crown and taking her first walk as Miss Universe continue to hold a special place in India's pop culture memory. Here are five defining moments from her historic 1994 win.
Sushmita Sen Miss Universe: 5 Defining Moments From 1994
1. The Miss India tiebreaker against Aishwarya Rai
Before she represented India internationally, Sen had to win a closely contested national title. At the Femina Miss India 1994 pageant, she competed against Aishwarya Rai, with both contestants reportedly scoring 9.33 after the question-and-answer round. The result came down to a tiebreaker.
Asked about India's textile heritage and its history, Sen spoke about Mahatma Gandhi's Khadi movement. Her answer earned her an average score of 9.41, edging Rai's 9.39. Sen was crowned Femina Miss India Universe, while Rai won the Miss India World title. The result set the stage for two Indian women to make their mark on international pageantry that year.
2. Making It through the Miss Universe preliminary rounds
Sen travelled to Manila, Philippines, to compete against 76 other contestants at Miss Universe 1994. The competition involved several rounds, including interviews, swimsuit presentations and evening gowns. Her performance earned her a place among the Top 10 semifinalists.
One of the memorable elements of her pageant appearance was her confidence on stage. Wearing a deep-blue swimsuit with a white fringed wrap, she carried herself with ease during the swimsuit presentation. She subsequently advanced to the Top 6, putting India within reach of its first Miss Universe crown.
3. Her answer about spending time with children
The Top 6 interview round gave Sen another opportunity to stand out. Grammy Award-winning singer and actress Florence LaRue asked her what she would do if she had the time and money to embark upon a great adventure.
Sen spoke about spending time with children, explaining that they could bring adventure into one's life. She also expressed her desire to spend time with children from disadvantaged backgrounds, while emphasising that every child deserved attention and care.
The answer revealed a more personal side of the contestant beyond the usual pageant introductions. It also preceded the final question that would become the most remembered part of her performance.
4. The answer that won her The Miss Universe crown
The final question asked Sen, "What for you is the essence of being a woman?" Her response went on to become one of the most recognisable answers in the pageant's history.
She replied, "Just being a woman is a gift of God that all of us must appreciate. The origin of a child is a mother, who is a woman. She shows a man what caring, sharing and loving is all about. That's the essence of being a woman."
The answer, delivered during the final interview round of Miss Universe 1994, helped secure her victory. Sen later revisited the moment in an interview with her daughter Alisah's school magazine, published in 2022. She recalled that she had studied in a Hindi-medium school and did not know much English at the time. Reflecting on the word 'essence', she said she was surprised by how clearly she had understood the question.
5. The single spotlight and a historic crowning
The announcement of the winner remains one of the most striking parts of Sen's Miss Universe story. In a 2026 interview with NDTV, the actress recalled how the lights went off across the massive Manila stage when India was announced. A single spotlight then followed her.
Recalling the experience, Sen said, "There was this moment where I realised that all the lights on the stage - it's an experience. And it's very difficult to describe unless you're there. It was a massive stage in Manila; all the lights were gigantic. In that one moment, when they announced India, all the house lights and the stage lights were switched off. A single spot followed me."
Puerto Rico's Dayanara Torres, the reigning Miss Universe 1993, crowned Sen on May 21, 1994, at the Philippine International Convention Center. She became the first Indian woman to win the title, beating 76 other contestants and giving India a landmark victory on the international stage.
Sushmita Sen's Miss Universe Legacy
More than three decades later, Sen's victory remains an important chapter in India's pageant history. Her answers, stage presence and final walk are still revisited whenever the country celebrates a new generation of beauty queens. With Jennifer Barreto now beginning her reign as Miss Universe 2026, Sen's Manila victory is a reminder of how one performance can become part of a country's cultural memory.

title: 5 Books Shortlisted for 2026 Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Prize
description: These span the making of India’s Constitution, the arc of its development since Independence, the Partitions that shaped modern Asia and two lives, in particular, that moved through these histories
author: Age Correspondent
content:
5 Books Shortlisted for 2026 Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Prize
These span the making of India’s Constitution, the arc of its development since Independence, the Partitions that shaped modern Asia and two lives, in particular, that moved through these histories
New Delhi: The New India Foundation (NIF) has announced the shortlist for this year’s Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize (KCBP). It comprises five outstanding works of non-fiction on modern and contemporary India, all published in 2025.
These are: A Man for All Seasons: The Life of K.M. Panikkar (Westland Context) by Narayani Basu; Shattered Lands: Five Partitions and the Making of Modern Asia (HarperCollins Fourth Estate) by Sam Dalrymple; Assembling India’s Constitution: A New Democratic History (Penguin Random House Allen Lane) by Rohit De and Ornit Shani; A Sixth of Humanity: Independent India’s Development Odyssey (HarperCollins) by Devesh Kapur and Arvind Subramanian; and The Secret Master: Arun Kashalkar and a Journey to the Edge of Music (Westland Context) by Sumana Ramanan.
These five books span the making of India’s Constitution, the arc of its development since Independence, and the Partitions that shaped modern Asia. They also follow the lives that moved through these histories, from a statesman and diplomat to a Hindustani musician, showing how a nation is built and sustained.
The 2026 KCBP shortlist was selected by an eminent jury comprising chairman of Tata Sons and Tata Group N. Chandrasekaran, political scientist Niraja Gopal Jayal, partner at Trilegal Rahul Matthan, historian of science Jahnavi Phalkey, historian Srinath Raghavan, former foreign secretary of India Nirupama Rao, and entrepreneur Manish Sabharwal.
The winner will be announced in December, and the prize will be presented on December 12 at the Bangalore Literature Festival 2026. The winning author will receive a cash prize of ₹15 lakh.
Announcing the shortlist, chair of the jury, Niraja Gopal Jayal said, “We are delighted with this year’s shortlist. The five books demonstrate the value of rigorous, imaginative non-fiction in deepening our understanding of India and are exceptional in their ability to bring important aspects of the country’s experience into focus. It is heartening to see such a breadth of scholarship represented in this shortlist.”
Instituted in 2018, the NIF Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay Book Prize is India’s largest and most prestigious book prize for non-fiction books on modern and contemporary India. The work can be originally written in English or translated into English, and welcomes a wide range of non-fiction genres.
Previous winners include Aparajith Ramnath (2025) for Engineering a Nation: The Life and Career of M. Visvesvaraya, Ashok Gopal (2024) for A Part Apart: The Life and Thought of B.R. Ambedkar, Akshaya Mukul (2023) for Writer, Rebel, Soldier, Lover: The Many Lives of Agyeya, and more.

title: Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee’s 125th Birth Anniversary Observed In Odisha's Balasore
description: Speakers highlight his contribution to nation-building, national integration and education
author: Akshay Kumar Sahoo
content:
Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee’s 125th Birth Anniversary Observed In Odisha's Balasore
Speakers highlight his contribution to nation-building, national integration and education
Balasore (Odisha): Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee’s contribution to strengthening India’s national unity, territorial integrity and education system remains an enduring part of the country’s history, speakers said at a commemorative seminar organised in Balasore on Sunday to mark his 125th birth anniversary.
The seminar and cultural programme were organised by ‘Susree’, a leading cultural organisation based in Bhubaneswar, with the support of the Union ministry of culture, at the Satyasai Engineering College campus in Balasore district.
Former minister and Simulia MLA Padmalochan Panda, who attended the programme as the chief guest, recalled Mukherjee’s life and his contributions to the nation. Describing his struggle for national integrity and pride as an important chapter in Indian history, Panda urged the younger generation to draw inspiration from his patriotism, sacrifice and commitment to public life.
Senior journalist Gangadhar Rout spoke about Mukherjee’s political career, intellectual abilities and unwavering commitment to national unity. He emphasised the need to familiarise the younger generation with the lives and ideas of distinguished personalities who had shaped the country's history.
Senior BJP leader and Balasore district party president Iswar Chandra Behera highlighted Mukherjee’s nationalist philosophy and dedication to public service. He said his thoughts on national unity, sovereignty and cultural consciousness continued to hold relevance in contemporary India.
Senior advocate Harekrishna Dash dwelt on Mukherjee’s contribution to safeguarding the country's unity and integrity and promoting peace.
Senior BJP leaders Ganesh Prasad Mohapatra and Chandrasekhar Nanda, along with journalists Kishore Das and Gangadhar Rout, also shared their views on Mukherjee’s political philosophy, principles and contribution to nation-building. They stressed the importance of making his life and ideals subjects of study for future generations.
In his address, senior journalist Akshaya Kumar Sahoo highlighted Mukherjee’s multifaceted personality, his contributions as an educationist and his role in the political and constitutional history of independent India.
He observed that one of Mukherjee’s defining qualities was his ability to place national interests above political differences while remaining steadfast in his convictions. Sahoo emphasised that the contributions of historical personalities should be examined through an objective and impartial historical perspective, while also assessing the contemporary relevance of their ideas.
Following the seminar in Balasore, a cultural programme was organised in Bhubaneswar, featuring performances by the city-based dance institutions Nrutyadham, Nrutyankita and Nrutyayan.
The seminar was coordinated by Rajesh Samantaray, along with Sushree secretary Jayashree Patnaik and coordinator Subhashree Patnaik.

title: CM Majhi Pitches Odisha As Semiconductor Hub, Cites Rs 10,899-cr Pipeline
description: ‘From mines to minds, Odisha emerging as chip-and-data frontier’
author: Akshay Kumar Sahoo
content:
CM Majhi Pitches Odisha As Semiconductor Hub, Cites Rs 10,899-cr Pipeline
‘From mines to minds, Odisha emerging as chip-and-data frontier’
New Delhi/ Bhubaneswar: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Friday pitched the State as an emerging semiconductor manufacturing hub, highlighting investments of Rs 10,899 crore in five semiconductor projects and asserting that Odisha was building a complete ecosystem spanning chip manufacturing, advanced packaging, materials, skills and research.
Addressing SEMICON India 2026 at Yashobhoomi here, Mr Majhi said Odisha had secured two of the 12 projects approved under the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM), with the approved projects nationally representing investments of more than Rs 1.64 lakh crore.
The five semiconductor projects approved by Odisha, he said, would generate more than 4,500 direct jobs and over 16,000 indirect employment opportunities. The projects cover Silicon Carbide (SiC) semiconductors, advanced packaging, glass-substrate packaging, memory-module assembly and power electronics, with applications in electric vehicles, railways, defence and energy.
Mr Majhi said SiCSem Pvt Ltd was setting up what he described as India’s first integrated SiC semiconductor fabrication and packaging facility, while Heterogeneous Integration Packaging Solutions (HIPS/3DGS) was establishing an advanced glass-substrate packaging facility aimed at emerging applications such as artificial intelligence and high-performance computing.
Odisha has also attracted investments from RIR Power Electronics, Sancode Technologies and ASP Semicon in SiC power devices, advanced packaging and memory-module OSAT operations.
The Chief Minister said RIR Power Electronics had completed installation of SiC epitaxial wafer manufacturing reactors at its Bhubaneswar facility and was expected to commence commercial production soon.
He said the State was also pursuing a further investment pipeline, including discussions to translate the Intel-3DGS MoU into a large-scale advanced glass-substrate and packaging project. Talks were also underway with Sancode Technologies for a second-phase advanced packaging facility, while SiCSem was exploring a combined SiC and gallium nitride (GaN) fabrication and packaging facility.
Mr Majhi said Odisha had also approved a Rs 452-crore National Industry Co-Development Hub on Integrated Power Electronics at IIT Bhubaneswar, jointly funded by the Centre, State government, Anusandhan National Research Foundation and industry partners.
Referring to the Centre’s Semicon 2.0 initiative, he said Odisha was among the first States to align its semiconductor policy with the new programme. The State, he said, would provide an additional 25 per cent fiscal support on eligible capital expenditure for ISM-approved projects, including semiconductor equipment, semiconductor-grade chemicals, gases and materials.
Mr Majhi said Odisha was simultaneously developing its third IT park over about 1,000 acres to complement the semiconductor ecosystem.
“It means a full ecosystem, not only limited to a plant,” he said, arguing that anchor investments could attract suppliers and allied industries, creating a cluster-based industrial ecosystem.
He also stressed employment opportunities for Odisha’s youth, saying the objective was to enable engineers from places such as Keonjhar, Rourkela and Berhampur to build their careers within the State.
“Build a chip in Odisha — Build for the world,” Mr Majhi said, describing Odisha as a potential hub for compound semiconductors, advanced packaging and semiconductor ecosystem manufacturing.
“From mines to minds, Odisha is becoming India’s newest chip-and-data frontier,” he said, inviting global technology companies, investors and entrepreneurs to participate in the State’s semiconductor expansion.
The SiCSem project’s Rs 3,406-crore investment and 1,270-job projection were separately confirmed by the Press Information Bureau on September 15, while the State government has described the 3DGS glass-substrate facility as a first-of-its-kind project in India

AIADMK Tightens Media Protocol: Prior Clearance Must for Giving Interviews, Statements
According to a headquarters announcement made with the approval of General Secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami, functionaries across ranks must secure clearance from the party leadership before speaking to newspapers, television channels, or other media platforms, or before releasing any statement
Chennai: The AIADMK on Wednesday directed party office-bearers across all levels—including headquarters secretaries, district secretaries, and spokespersons—to obtain approval from the party leadership before giving media interviews, expressing views on party stands, or issuing statements.
According to a headquarters announcement made with the approval of General Secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami, functionaries across ranks must secure clearance from the party leadership before speaking to newspapers, television channels, or other media platforms, or before releasing any statement.
The announcement, made through a statement, urged all office-bearers involved in the party's growth to comply with the order in full.
It also said that the party has been "marching forward as a disciplined movement" with the blessings of party founder MG Ramachandran and late General Secretary J Jayalalithaa.

title: Fire Breaks Out in Govt School Noon-Meal Kitchen in Tiruvarur; Students Safe
description: The incident occurred at the Panchayat Union Middle School in Melathirumathikunnam village in Koradacheri taluk, where more than 100 students are enrolled
author: PTI
content:
Fire Breaks Out in Govt School Noon-Meal Kitchen in Tiruvarur; Students Safe
The incident occurred at the Panchayat Union Middle School in Melathirumathikunnam village in Koradacheri taluk, where more than 100 students are enrolled
Tiruvarur: A fire broke out in the noon-meal kitchen of a government school in Tiruvarur district on Wednesday due to a gas leak, prompting the immediate evacuation of over 100 students to a nearby temple, officials said.
No one was injured in the incident, they added.
The incident occurred at the Panchayat Union Middle School in Melathirumathikunnam village in Koradacheri taluk, where more than 100 students are enrolled.
While the midday meal was being prepared, gas leaked through a hole in the cylinder's tube, led to the fire. A panicked noon-meal worker raised an alarm and attempted to put out the flames, but the fire spread rapidly.
Hearing the commotion, nearby residents and parents rushed to the school and managed to douse the fire on the gas cylinder using wet gunny bags and wet cloths.
Teachers immediately evacuated all the students and safely sheltered them at a nearby Perumal temple. The incident triggered brief tension in the locality.

content:
Hyderabad: Man Stabbed With Knife During Mobile Phone Snatching Attempt
According to reports, the accused attempted to snatch the phone from the victim, identified as Ramesh. During the ensuing scuffle, the thief stabbed him with a knife and fled with the mobile phone.
Hyderabad: A man was stabbed with a knife by a thief who allegedly tried to snatch his mobile phone near Chintalakunta in Vanasthalipuram, Hyderabad on Wednesday.
According to reports, the accused attempted to snatch the phone from the victim, identified as Ramesh. During the ensuing scuffle, the thief stabbed him with a knife and fled with the mobile phone.
On receiving information about the incident, the police rushed to the spot and shifted the injured man to a hospital for treatment.
A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

Rajasthan Zila Pramukh Election 2026 Live: सवाई माधोपुर में कांग्रेस की आशा बैरवा निर्विरोध बनीं जिला प्रमुख; भाजपा नहीं उतार सकी प्रत्याशी
Rajasthan Zila Pramukh Election 2026 Live: सवाई माधोपुर में कांग्रेस ने जिला प्रमुख चुनाव में बड़ी जीत दर्ज की है, वार्ड नंबर 15 से जिला परिषद सदस्य आशा बैरवा निर्विरोध जिला प्रमुख चुनी गई. भाजपा अपना प्रत्याशी...और पढ़ें
37 जिला परिषदों के हालिया चुनावी नतीजों में कांग्रेस का पलड़ा काफी भारी नजर आ रहा है. कांग्रेस को 22 से 23 जिला परिषदों में स्पष्ट बहुमत हासिल है, जिनमें जयपुर, जोधपुर, अलवर, सीकर, बीकानेर, भरतपुर, बाड़मेर, भीलवाड़ा, चूरू, दौसा, चित्तौड़गढ़ और झुंझुनूं जैसे प्रमुख जिले शामिल हैं. दूसरी तरफ सत्ताधारी भारतीय जनता पार्टी को महज पांच जिलों अजमेर, ब्यावर, झालावाड़, पाली और उदयपुर में ही अपने दम पर स्पष्ट बहुमत मिल पाया है. नागौर जिला परिषद में राष्ट्रीय लोकतांत्रिक पार्टी को स्पष्ट बहुमत मिला है, जहां आरएलपी अपना जिला प्रमुख बनाने की मजबूत स्थिति में है.
प्रदेश के करीब 8 से 9 जिले ऐसे हैं जहां किसी भी राजनीतिक दल को स्पष्ट बहुमत नहीं मिला है. इनमें बालोतरा, बांसवाड़ा, डीडवाना-कुचामन, डीग, डूंगरपुर, खैरथल-तिजारा, प्रतापगढ़ और सलूंबर प्रमुख हैं. इन जिलों में निर्दलीय सदस्य और छोटे क्षेत्रीय दल किंगमेकर की भूमिका निभाएंगे. पंचायत राज चुनावों में दलबदल विरोधी कानून लागू न होने के कारण क्रॉस वोटिंग और जोड़तोड़ की संभावनाएं भी बढ़ गई हैं. इसी वजह से दोनों दलों ने अपने सदस्यों की बाड़ेबंदी की है और प्रत्याशियों के नाम अंतिम समय तक गोपनीय रखे हैं.
सरपंच चुनाव

Dausa Zila Pramukh Election 2026: दौसा में कांग्रेस की बीना बैरवा बनीं जिला प्रमुख, BJP ने नहीं उतारा था कोई उम्मीदवार
दौसा जिला प्रमुख चुनाव में कांग्रेस ने जीत दर्ज करते हुए बीना बैरवा को दौसा का नया जिला प्रमुख बना दिया है. रिटर्निंग अधिकारी डॉ. सौम्या झा ने नवनिर्वाचित जिला प्रमुख बीना बैरवा को प्रमाण पत्र सौंपा और पद एवं गोपनीयता की शपथ दिलाई. खास बात यह है कि बीना बैरवा दौसा से कांग्रेस विधायक दीनदयाल बैरवा की पत्नी हैं. वहीं, भारतीय जनता पार्टी की ओर से जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए कोई नामांकन दाखिल नहीं किया गया था. ऐसे में बीना बैरवा का जिला प्रमुख बनना तय हो गया था.
Hanumangarh Zila Pramukh Election 2026: हनुमानगढ़ में जिला प्रमुख की कुर्सी पर कांग्रेस का कब्जा तय, रेणु जांगू और सरस्वती देवी के बीच मुकाबला
हनुमानगढ़ जिला प्रमुख चुनाव को लेकर जिले में राजनीतिक सरगर्मियां तेज हो गई हैं, जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए कांग्रेस की रेणु जांगू और भाजपा की सरस्वती देवी के बीच मुकाबला होगा. हालांकि, जिला परिषद में कांग्रेस के पास स्पष्ट बहुमत होने के चलते रेणु जांगू का जिला प्रमुख बनना लगभग तय माना जा रहा है. 37 जोन वाली जिला परिषद में कांग्रेस ने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए 26 सीटों पर जीत दर्ज की है. ऐसे में भाजपा प्रत्याशी के सामने कांग्रेस के मजबूत बहुमत के चलते चुनौती काफी मुश्किल मानी जा रही है.
Dungarpur Zila Pramukh Election 2026: डूंगरपुर में जिला प्रमुख चुनाव का रोमांच, कांग्रेस कर सकती है वोटिंग का बहिष्कार; BJP-BAP में सीधी टक्कर
डूंगरपुर जिला प्रमुख चुनाव को लेकर जिले में सियासी हलचल तेज हो गई है, चुनाव में कांग्रेस की ओर से उम्मीदवार नहीं उतारे जाने के चलते पार्टी वोटिंग का बहिष्कार कर सकती है. ऐसे में जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए भाजपा और बीएपी के बीच सीधी टक्कर होने की संभावना है. हालांकि, 37 सीटों वाली जिला परिषद में किसी भी दल के पास स्पष्ट बहुमत नहीं है. भाजपा और बीएपी दोनों के पास 14-14 सीटें हैं. ऐसे में जिला प्रमुख की कुर्सी पर किसका कब्जा होगा, यह चुनाव के दौरान होने वाले सियासी समीकरणों और अन्य सदस्यों के रुख पर निर्भर करेगा.
पहली बार बालोतरा को मिलेगा जिला प्रमुख, BJP-कांग्रेस में सीधा मुकाबला; RLP के हाथ में सत्ता की चाबी
बालोतरा जिले के लिए आज का दिन ऐतिहासिक होने जा रहा है, जिले को पहली बार अपना जिला प्रमुख मिलेगा. जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए बीजेपी की ओर से सुशीला और कांग्रेस की ओर से फुलाराम भील ने नामांकन दाखिल किया है. जिला परिषद में बीजेपी के 12, कांग्रेस के 12 और RLP के 7 सदस्य हैं. ऐसे में जिला प्रमुख की कुर्सी का फैसला RLP के सदस्यों के रुख पर निर्भर करेगा. दोनों ही प्रमुख दलों के बीच कड़ा मुकाबला माना जा रहा है और सत्ता की चाबी RLP के हाथ में है. दोपहर 3 बजे से मतदान शुरू होगा, जबकि शाम 5 बजे तक नतीजे घोषित कर जिला प्रमुख के नाम का ऐलान किया जाएगा.
Sawaimadhopur Zila Pramukh Election 2026: सवाई माधोपुर में कांग्रेस का दबदबा, आशा बैरवा निर्विरोध बनीं जिला प्रमुख; भाजपा नहीं उतार सकी प्रत्याशी
सवाई माधोपुर जिला प्रमुख चुनाव 2026 में सवाई माधोपुर से कांग्रेस के लिए बड़ी खबर सामने आई है. वार्ड नंबर 15 से नवनिर्वाचित कांग्रेस जिला परिषद सदस्य आशा बैरवा ने जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए नामांकन दाखिल किया. उनके अलावा किसी अन्य प्रत्याशी ने नामांकन नहीं भरा, जिसके चलते आशा बैरवा निर्विरोध जिला प्रमुख निर्वाचित हो गई. खास बात यह रही कि भाजपा जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए अपना प्रत्याशी तक नहीं उतार सकी. निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया के दौरान विधायक रामकेश मीणा, विधायक इंदिरा मीणा, पूर्व विधायक दानिश अबरार और अशोक बैरवा मौजूद रहे. गौरतलब है कि सवाई माधोपुर की 31 जिला परिषद सीटों में से कांग्रेस ने 26 सीटों पर जीत दर्ज की थी.
Alwar Zila Pramukh Election 2026: कांग्रेस ने अनीता मीणा को बनाया उम्मीदवार, जिला अध्यक्ष बोले- पार्टी पूरी तरह एकजुट
अलवर जिला प्रमुख चुनाव 2026 को लेकर अलवर की सियासत में हलचल तेज हो गई है। कांग्रेस ने वार्ड नंबर 16 से नवनिर्वाचित जिला पार्षद अनीता मीणा को पार्टी के शीर्ष नेतृत्व की सहमति से सर्वसम्मति से जिला प्रमुख पद का उम्मीदवार घोषित किया है। प्रत्याशी घोषित होने के बाद अनीता मीणा जिला परिषद पहुंचीं और अपना नामांकन दाखिल किया। जिला कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष प्रकाश गंगावत ने कहा कि कांग्रेस के सभी जिला परिषद सदस्य और प्रत्याशी पूरी तरह एकजुट हैं। उन्होंने भाजपा पर खरीद-फरोख्त और हॉर्स ट्रेडिंग की कोशिशों का आरोप लगाते हुए कहा कि भाजपा ने कांग्रेस प्रत्याशियों में फूट डालने के काफी प्रयास किए, लेकिन उसकी कोशिशें सफल नहीं होंगी। कांग्रेस का दावा है कि पार्टी में कोई टूट नहीं है और सभी सदस्य एकजुट होकर चुनाव लड़ेंगे।
Pali Zila Pramukh Election 2026: पाली जिला प्रमुख चुनाव से पहले भाजपा में घमासान, चौथाराम की नाराजगी से बढ़ा क्रॉस वोटिंग का डर
पाली जिला प्रमुख चुनाव से पहले पाली में भाजपा के अंदर सियासी घमासान तेज हो गया है. जिला परिषद सदस्य चौथाराम को जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए नामांकन दाखिल नहीं करने देने से वे नाराज हो गए. इसके बाद भाजपा पदाधिकारी उन्हें अपने साथ सांसद सेवा केंद्र ले गए, जहां उन्हें समझाने का प्रयास किया जा रहा है. वहीं, कांग्रेस ने भाजपा पर वोट चोरी का आरोप लगाते हुए निर्वाचित सदस्य को जबरन बंधक बनाने का दावा किया है. विधायक भीमराज भाटी के नेतृत्व में कांग्रेस नेता सांसद सेवा केंद्र पहुंचे और चौथाराम को बाहर निकालने की मांग की. पाली जिला परिषद के 33 वार्डों में से 19 पर भाजपा और 14 पर कांग्रेस के सदस्य निर्वाचित हुए हैं. ऐसे में चौथाराम की नाराजगी ने भाजपा की चिंता बढ़ा दी है और पार्टी को क्रॉस वोटिंग का डर सताने लगा है.

title: UP Chunav 2027 LIVE: 'जीतने वाली पहली 26 सीटों से हुई है शुरुआत, मिलजुलकर समझदारी से और आगे बढ़ेगी बात', यू...
description: UP Chunav 2027 LIVE: उत्तर प्रदेश में 2027 विधानसभा चुनाव को लेकर सियासी हलचल तेज है. सपा-कांग्रेस के बीच मंगलवार को सीट बंटवारे पर दूसरे दौर की बैठक हुई. सपा ने कांग्रेस को केवल 26 सीटें ऑफर की है, जिसके जवाब में कांग्रेस सांसद इमरान मसूद ने कहा कि भीख नहीं मांग रहा. इसके बाद सपा अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव ने कहा- 'जीतनेवाली पहली ‘26 सीटों’ से हुई है शुरुआत, मिलजुलकर समझदारी से और आगे बढ़ेगी बात'. रामगोपाल यादव ने कहा कि दोनों दलों की तीसरी मीटिंग को लेकर जल्द ही नई तारीख तय होगी. सपा ने सीट शेयरिंग कमेटी में अयोध्या सांसद अवधेश प्रसाद को शामिल किया है. दलित प्रतिनिधित्व के सवालों के बाद कमेटी का विस्तार किया गया है. अब इसमें पांच सदस्य होंगे. उधर, बीजेपी सहयोगी दलों से रणनीति पर चर्चा कर सकती है. संजय निषाद ने NDA में 35-37 सीटों पर दावा किया है. अजय राय ने गठबंधन जारी रहने का भरोसा जताया. ओवैसी-चंद्रशेखर 26 नवंबर की रैली की तैयारी में हैं. अखिलेश की वेबसाइट पर 48 घंटे में 1500 सुझाव मिले. CEO नवदीप रिनवा ने मतदाता सूची पुनरीक्षण की समीक्षा की.

एनडीए घटक दलों से बीजेपी की रणनीतिक बातचीत
‘अखिलेश सुन रहे हैं’ को शुरुआती 48 घंटे में करीब 1500 प्रतिवेदन
UP Election 2027 LIVE: सीट शेयरिंग कमेटी में शामिल होने पर बोले अवधेश प्रसाद- अखिलेश यादव के भरोसे पर खरा उतरूंगा
कांग्रेस के साथ सीट बंटवारे पर बातचीत के लिए समाजवादी पार्टी ने अपनी कमेटी में अयोध्या से सांसद अवधेश प्रसाद को शामिल किया है. इस फैसले पर अवधेश प्रसाद ने कहा कि यह सपा के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव की दरियादिली है. उन्होंने उन पर भरोसा जताया है और वह इस भरोसे पर खरा उतरेंगे. अवधेश प्रसाद ने सीट शेयरिंग को लेकर किसी तरह के विवाद से इनकार किया. उन्होंने कहा कि दोनों दलों के बीच बातचीत से सभी मुद्दे आसानी से सुलझ जाएंगे. अब सपा की पांच सदस्यीय कमेटी कांग्रेस के साथ सीटों के बंटवारे पर चर्चा करेगी.
यूपी विधानसभा चुनाव 2027 लाइव: सीट-दर-सीट होगा सपा-कांग्रेस में मंथन, राजीव राय बोले- BJP सरकार को हटाना साझा लक्ष्य
उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव 2027 के लिए सपा और कांग्रेस के बीच सीट बंटवारे पर बातचीत जारी है. सपा नेता राजीव राय ने कहा कि दोनों दलों के बीच सीट-दर-सीट चर्चा होगी. इसमें यह आकलन किया जाएगा कि किस सीट पर कौन सी पार्टी जीतने की स्थिति में है और गठबंधन अपनी ताकत कैसे बढ़ा सकता है. उन्होंने कहा कि दोनों पार्टियों का शीर्ष नेतृत्व इस बात पर पूरी तरह सहमत है कि बीजेपी सरकार को सत्ता से हटाना है. राजीव राय के मुताबिक, इस लक्ष्य को हासिल करने के लिए दोनों दल अपनी-अपनी जिम्मेदारियां निभाएंगे.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: आजम खान के बयान पर चंद्रशेखर आजाद का जवाब, बोले- मेरा हथियार कलम है, खंजर नहीं
दिल्ली में नगीना से सांसद और आजाद समाज पार्टी (कांशीराम) के प्रमुख चंद्रशेखर आजाद ने सपा नेता आजम खान के बयान पर प्रतिक्रिया दी. उन्होंने कहा कि आजम खान अभी-अभी जेल से लौटे हैं. उनका और सामाजिक परिवर्तन मोर्चा का संघर्ष सत्ता में बैठे लोगों के खिलाफ है. चंद्रशेखर ने कहा, “मेरा हथियार कलम है, मैं खंजर में विश्वास नहीं करता.” उन्होंने आजम खान से किसी तरह की शिकायत होने से भी इनकार किया. चंद्रशेखर ने कहा कि एक वरिष्ठ नेता के तौर पर आजम खान को अपनी पार्टी और नेताओं से जुड़े समीकरण संभालने होते हैं. हो सकता है कि उनकी कुछ मजबूरियां रही हों. उन्होंने कहा कि दोनों के रिश्ते इतने खराब नहीं हैं कि इस तरह की बातें कही जाएं.

बीजेपी अल्पसंख्यक मोर्चा के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष कुंवर बासित अली ने सपा और कांग्रेस के गठबंधन पर निशाना साधा है. उन्होंने कहा कि दोनों दलों के बीच लड़ाई बीजेपी से नहीं, बल्कि सीटों और सत्ता में हिस्सेदारी को लेकर है. बासित अली के मुताबिक, सपा-कांग्रेस के नेता आपस में ज्यादा से ज्यादा सीटें हासिल करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं. उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि दोनों दलों के नेताओं ने अतीत में एक-दूसरे पर भ्रष्टाचार और घोटालों के आरोप लगाए हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि गठबंधन में मलाई और सत्ता के बंटवारे को लेकर चर्चा हो रही है. बासित अली ने दावा किया कि बीजेपी सरकार की वापसी होगी.

उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव 2027 से पहले निषाद पार्टी के अध्यक्ष और योगी सरकार में मंत्री संजय निषाद ने NDA के साथ मजबूती से खड़े रहने का दावा किया है. उन्होंने कहा कि निषाद समाज फिलहाल निषाद पार्टी के साथ है और आगे भी रहेगा. संजय निषाद ने भाजपा की तारीफ करते हुए कहा कि 70 साल में पहली बार निषाद समाज के लिए अलग मंत्रालय और बजट की व्यवस्था हुई है. प्रधानमंत्री ने भी जय निषाद राज का नारा दिया है. उन्होंने कहा कि भाजपा आरक्षण के मुद्दे पर पहल कर रही है और वह इस पहल के साथ हैं. सीटों के बंटवारे पर संजय निषाद ने 35 से 37 सीटों पर दावा जताया. हालांकि, उन्होंने स्पष्ट किया कि किस दल को कितनी सीटें मिलेंगी, इसका फैसला NDA करेगा.
UP Chunav 2027 LIVE: यूपी की वोटर लिस्ट में एक लाख डुप्लीकेट मतदाताओं की पहचान का सपा का दावा
समाजवादी पार्टी ने उत्तर प्रदेश की मतदाता सूची में करीब एक लाख डुप्लीकेट मतदाताओं की पहचान करने का दावा किया है. पार्टी के प्रदेश अध्यक्ष श्यामलाल पाल ने सोमवार को मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी नवदीप रिणवा को ज्ञापन सौंपकर घोषित नकद पुरस्कार की पूरी राशि देने की मांग की. सपा के मुताबिक, प्रदेश की सभी 403 विधानसभा सीटों के 1.73 लाख से अधिक मतदान केंद्रों की मतदाता सूची की जांच में ये नाम सामने आए हैं. पार्टी ने दावा किया कि कई मतदाताओं के नाम, पते और अन्य विवरण एक जैसे हैं, लेकिन उनके EPIC नंबर अलग-अलग हैं. सपा ने इनकी सूची निर्वाचन अधिकारियों को ईमेल से भेजी है. साथ ही मतदाता सूची की विसंगतियां दूर करने के लिए अभियान चलाने की मांग की, ताकि 2027 का चुनाव निष्पक्ष हो सके.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: यूपी की सभी 403 सीटों पर चुनाव की तैयारी कर रही लोजपा (रामविलास), अरुण भारती का दावा
लोक जनशक्ति पार्टी (रामविलास) उत्तर प्रदेश की सभी 403 विधानसभा सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ने की तैयारी कर रही है. पार्टी के प्रदेश प्रभारी और जमुई से सांसद अरुण भारती ने सोमवार को बलिया में यह जानकारी दी. उन्होंने कहा कि चिराग पासवान के नेतृत्व में पार्टी विधानसभा चुनाव लड़ेगी. गठबंधन के सवाल पर उन्होंने कहा कि इस संबंध में फैसला लेने का अधिकार चिराग पासवान को है. भारती ने ‘पंडित, पासी और पासवान’ का नारा देते हुए संगठन को गांव और बूथ स्तर पर मजबूत करने की बात कही. उन्होंने बताया कि 28 नवंबर को रायबरेली में पार्टी के स्थापना दिवस पर ‘बहुजन बिंद संकल्प समागम’ आयोजित होगा. भारती ने प्रदेश के सभी 75 जिलों का दौरा कर संगठन मजबूत करने की बात भी कही.

title: नूंह में एक्सप्रेसवे पुल से नीचे गिरा ट्रक, हॉलिवुड के एक्शन फिल्म की तरह मची तबाही; मचा हड़कंप
description: Delhi Mumbai Expressway Accident: रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, हादसे के समय ट्रक में तीन लोग सवार थे. खबर है कि एक व्यक्ति समय रहते ट्रक से कूद गया, जबकि ड्राइवर और हेल्पर अंदर ही फंस गए. ट्रक के पुल से गिरने की आवाज सुनकर आस-पास के गांव वाले मौके पर पहुंचे.
author: Divyanshi Singh
content:
Delhi-Mumbai Expressway Truck Accident: बुधवार सुबह करीब 3:30 बजे नूह में दिल्ली-मुंबई एक्सप्रेसवे पर एक सड़क हादसा हुआ. जयपुर से दिल्ली जा रहा एक ट्रक पथराली गांव के पास पुल नंबर 72/1 पर अचानक कंट्रोल खो बैठा.ट्रक पुल से नीचे गिर गया, जिससे डिवाइडर पर लगे पेड़-पौधे करीब 500 मीटर तक कुचल गए. हादसे से मौके पर अफरा-तफरी मच गई
ट्रक में सवार थे तीन लोग
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, हादसे के समय ट्रक में तीन लोग सवार थे. खबर है कि एक व्यक्ति समय रहते ट्रक से कूद गया, जबकि ड्राइवर और हेल्पर अंदर ही फंस गए. ट्रक के पुल से गिरने की आवाज सुनकर आस-पास के गांव वाले मौके पर पहुंचे.गांव वालों ने तुरंत बचाव और राहत का काम शुरू किया. काफी मशक्कत के बाद ड्राइवर और हेल्पर को ट्रक से बाहर निकाला गया. फिर दोनों को इलाज के लिए हॉस्पिटल ले जाया गया, जहां से उन्हें अलवर ले जाया गया.हालांकि, ट्रक में सवार तीसरे व्यक्ति की हालत के बारे में अभी कोई साफ जानकारी नहीं मिली है.
500 मीटर तक डिवाइडर पर पेड़-पौधों को रौंदा
हादसे की गंभीरता का अंदाज़ा इसी बात से लगाया जा सकता है कि पुल से गिरने से पहले ट्रक ने लगभग 500 मीटर तक डिवाइडर पर पेड़-पौधों को रौंदा. इस दौरान एक्सप्रेसवे के किनारे लगे पेड़-पौधों को भी नुकसान हुआ.अभी, ट्रक के कंट्रोल से बाहर होने का कारण साफ़ नहीं है. यह पता नहीं चल पाया है कि ड्राइवर को नींद आ गई थी या किसी टेक्निकल खराबी की वजह से उसने कंट्रोल खो दिया था.
पुलिस को घटना की जानकारी नहीं
जब सदर पुलिस स्टेशन फिरोजपुर झिरका के इंचार्ज चंद्रभान से संपर्क किया गया, तो उन्होंने ऐसी कोई जानकारी मिलने से इनकार किया. ऑफिशियल कन्फर्मेशन और हादसे के कारण का इंतज़ार है.

title: मां ने संबध बनाने से किया मना, तो 2 साल की बेटी को चॉकलेट का लालच देकर किया दुष्कर्म; बदले के आग में दरिंदा बना पति का दोस्त
description: Gujarat Crime: यह मामला गुजरात के भरूच जिले का है. पुलिस के मुताबिक आरोपी की पहचान 28 वर्षीय सुरेंद्रकुमार के रूप में हुई है. वह पीड़िता के पति का दोस्त बताया जा रहा है. आरोप है कि वह काफी समय से महिला पर उसके साथ अवैध संबंध बनाने का दबाव डाल रहा था.
author: Divyanshi Singh
content:
Gujarat Crime: गुजरात से इंसानियत को शर्मसार करने वाली एक बेहद दर्दनाक घटना सामने आई है. यहां एक महिला ने अपने पति के दोस्त के साथ अवैध संबंध बनाने से इनकार कर दिया तो आरोपी ने बदला लेने के लिए उसकी दो साल की मासूम बेटी को निशाना बनाया. आरोप है कि आरोपी ने बच्ची को चॉकलेट का लालच देकर अपने कमरे में बुलाया और उसके साथ दुष्कर्म किया. इस घटना में बच्ची के प्राइवेट पार्ट में गंभीर चोटें आई हैं. पुलिस ने आरोपी को गिरफ्तार कर लिया है.
महिला पर संबंध बनाने का बना रहा था दबाव
यह मामला गुजरात के भरूच जिले का है. पुलिस के मुताबिक आरोपी की पहचान 28 वर्षीय सुरेंद्रकुमार के रूप में हुई है. वह पीड़िता के पति का दोस्त बताया जा रहा है. आरोप है कि वह काफी समय से महिला पर उसके साथ अवैध संबंध बनाने का दबाव डाल रहा था.
महिला ने जब उसकी बात मानने से इनकार कर दिया, तो आरोपी ने उसे फोन पर गंभीर परिणाम भुगतने की धमकी दी. पुलिस के अनुसार, महिला के बार-बार मना करने से नाराज आरोपी ने उससे बदला लेने की साजिश रची और उसकी मासूम बेटी को निशाना बनाया.
चॉकलेट का लालच देकर बच्ची को कमरे में ले गया आरोपी
पीड़ित बच्ची की मां की ओर से दर्ज कराई गई शिकायत के मुताबिक, घटना के समय दो साल की बच्ची अपने घर के आंगन में खेल रही थी. इसी दौरान आरोपी उसके पास पहुंचा और उसे चॉकलेट देने का लालच दिया. इसके बाद वह बच्ची को अपने कमरे में ले गया, जहां उसने उसके साथ दुष्कर्म किया.
आरोप है कि इस दरिंदगी के कारण बच्ची के प्राइवेट पार्ट में गंभीर चोटें आईं. घटना की जानकारी मिलने के बाद परिवार में हड़कंप मच गया. इसके बाद बच्ची के परिजनों ने पुलिस में शिकायत दर्ज कराई.
POCSO एक्ट के तहत आरोपी गिरफ्तार
शिकायत मिलने के बाद पुलिस ने आरोपी के खिलाफ पॉक्सो (POCSO) एक्ट और अन्य संबंधित कानूनी प्रावधानों के तहत मामला दर्ज किया. पुलिस ने कार्रवाई करते हुए आरोपी को गिरफ्तार कर लिया.
इसके बाद आरोपी को भरूच की विशेष पॉक्सो अदालत में पेश किया गया. पुलिस ने मामले की आगे की जांच और पूछताछ के लिए उसकी रिमांड मांगी है. फिलहाल पुलिस पूरे मामले की जांच कर रही है.

title: Watch Video: महिला के साथ डांस के मजे ले रहे थे दिल्ली पुलिस के इंस्पेक्टर, 20 सेकेंड के वीडियो ने कराई फजीहत; लाइन हाजिर किए गए
description: Delhi Police Inspector Viral Video: दिल्ली के लाजपत नगर थाने में तैनात इंस्पेक्टर अमित प्रकाश का महिला के साथ डांस VIDEO वायरल हो गया. मामला सामने आने के बाद वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों ने उन्हें लाइन हाजिर कर दिया.
author: Preeti Rajput
content:
Delhi Police Inspector Viral Video: दिल्ली पुलिस के एक इंस्पेक्टर का महिला के साथ डांस करते हुए वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर तेजी से वायरल हो रहा है. वीडियो सामने आने के बाद पुलिस विभाग में हलचल मच गई. मामला दिल्ली के लाजपत नगर थाने में तैनात एक इंस्पेक्टर से जुड़ा है. बताया जा रहा है कि यह वीडियो रोहिणी में आयोजित एक दोस्त की जन्मदिन पार्टी का है. वीडियो वायरल होने के बाद पुलिस के वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों ने मामले का संज्ञान लिया और इंस्पेक्टर के खिलाफ कार्रवाई करते हुए उन्हें लाइन हाजिर कर दिया.
20 सेकेंड के डांस VIDEO ने बढ़ाई मुश्किल
जानकारी के मुताबिक, सोशल मीडिया पर मंगलवार को करीब 20 सेकेंड का एक वीडियो वायरल हुआ. इसमें दिल्ली पुलिस के लाजपत नगर थाने में अतिरिक्त थाना प्रभारी (ATO) के पद पर तैनात इंस्पेक्टर अमित प्रकाश एक महिला के साथ डांस करते नजर आ रहे हैं. वीडियो में वह सादी वर्दी में दिखाई दे रहे हैं. बताया जा रहा है कि यह वीडियो किसी सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम का नहीं, बल्कि रोहिणी में आयोजित उनके एक दोस्त की जन्मदिन पार्टी का है. वीडियो सामने आने के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर इसकी चर्चा शुरू हो गई.

वायरल वीडियो में दिखाई दे रहे इंस्पेक्टर अमित प्रकाश दिल्ली के लाजपत नगर थाने में अतिरिक्त थाना प्रभारी (ATO) के पद पर तैनात थे. वीडियो में उन्हें एक महिला के साथ डांस करते देखा जा सकता है. हालांकि, वीडियो के सामने आने के बाद पुलिस अधिकारियों ने मामले को गंभीरता से लिया.

title: Intense cold wave grips Kashmir and Ladakh; Shopian records -4.2°C, Dras freezes at -10.4°C
description: According to Meteorological Department data, Pahalgam recorded a minimum of -3.6°C, followed by Pulwama at -3.5°C, Anantnag at -2.8°C, Qazigund at -2.4°C, Kulgam at -0.4°C and Kokernag at -0.2°C.
content:
An intense and unusually early cold wave has tightened its grip on Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, with temperatures plunging several degrees below the freezing point across most parts of the two regions. Shopian recorded the lowest minimum temperature in the Kashmir Valley at -4.2°C, while Dras in Ladakh shivered at a bone-chilling -10.4°C.
Srinagar also experienced its coldest night of the season so far, with the minimum temperature settling at -1.9°C, around 2 degrees below the seasonal average. At Srinagar Airport, the mercury dipped further to -2.2°C.
The sharp drop in temperatures has disrupted normal morning activities, with frost covering roads, rooftops and open spaces across several areas. Residents have begun relying on traditional winter essentials, including pherans (woollen cloaks) and kangris (traditional fire pots), along with electric heating appliances, to cope with the biting cold.
South Kashmir has witnessed some of the sharpest temperature declines, with Shopian emerging as the coldest inhabited area in the Valley.
According to Meteorological Department data, Pahalgam recorded a minimum of -3.6°C, followed by Pulwama at -3.5°C, Anantnag at -2.8°C, Qazigund at -2.4°C, Kulgam at -0.4°C and Kokernag at -0.2°C.
In North and Central Kashmir, temperatures also remained close to or below the freezing point. Budgam and Awantipora recorded -2.4°C each, while Kupwara registered -2.0°C, Bandipora -1.5°C, Ganderbal -0.5°C and Baramulla -0.1°C. Gulmarg recorded 0.0°C, while Sonamarg registered a relatively higher minimum of 0.3°C.
Trending Stories
The cold wave has been particularly severe across the high-altitude areas of Ladakh, where temperatures have fallen sharply, freezing water sources and restricting outdoor activities.
Dras recorded a minimum temperature of -10.4°C, followed by Nyoma at -9.8°C, Leh at -8.6°C and Kargil at -7.2°C, indicating the onset of severe winter conditions across the cold desert region.
In contrast, the Jammu division experienced comparatively milder nighttime temperatures, although higher-altitude areas also witnessed a noticeable chill.
Bhaderwah was the coldest in the division at 3.2°C, followed by Udhampur at 6.0°C, Poonch at 6.1°C, Samba at 7.4°C, Reasi at 7.5°C and Jammu city at 9.8°C.
According to the Meteorological Department, no rainfall or snowfall was recorded anywhere across Jammu, Kashmir and Ladakh during the past 24 hours.
Meteorological officials attributed the sharp fall in nighttime temperatures to clear skies.The MeT Department has forecast predominantly dry weather across Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh until November 30, with no significant precipitation expected during this period.

title: 26/11: 18 years after Mumbai’s darkest night, the questions that refuse to die
description: Eighteen years after the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, revisit the tragedy, the heroes, security failures, major reforms and India's continuing pursuit of justice
content:
There are places in Mumbai where history is not confined to photographs, memorials or the pages of a newspaper. It is embedded in the walls, the corridors and the memories of people who were there. At the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, thousands of commuters continue to pass through a railway station that became one of the first scenes of carnage on November 26, 2008. The Taj Mahal Palace Hotel continues to welcome guests, but its name carries the memory of a night when parts of the iconic building were engulfed in flames. In Colaba, Chabad House, formerly known as Nariman House, remains associated with one of the most disturbing chapters of the attacks.
18 years have passed since ten heavily armed terrorists brought India’s financial capital to a standstill. Yet, November 26 remains more than a date of remembrance. It represents a defining moment in India’s security history, a test of its institutions and a tragedy whose impact continues to be felt by survivors and families. The attacks lasted nearly 60 hours. By the time the operation ended on November 29, 166 people had been killed and hundreds had been injured. Among the dead were Indian citizens, foreign nationals, police officers and members of the security forces.
But the story of 26/11 is not simply about the scale of destruction. It is also about how a group of terrorists managed to reach Mumbai, how they selected their targets, what happened during the prolonged siege and whether the country was adequately prepared for an attack of this nature.
A city attacked from the sea
The planning of the Mumbai attacks began long before the first shots were fired. Ten members of Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba travelled from Karachi towards Mumbai by sea. They hijacked an Indian fishing vessel, the MV Kuber, killed its crew and used an inflatable boat to reach the Mumbai coastline. They landed near Badhwar Park in Colaba on the evening of November 26, 2008. From there, the attackers split into groups and moved towards their designated targets. The choice of locations was significant. The terrorists targeted places associated with Mumbai’s public life, international visitors, business activity and religious communities.
The Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Leopold Cafe, Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, Oberoi-Trident Hotel and Nariman House were among the principal targets. The attacks were not confined to one neighbourhood or one building. They unfolded across different parts of South Mumbai, forcing police and security agencies to respond to multiple emergencies simultaneously. At CST, passengers waiting for trains were caught in indiscriminate gunfire. Leopold Cafe, popular with tourists and locals, became another scene of violence. At the Taj and Oberoi, guests and employees found themselves trapped inside buildings that had turned into battlegrounds.
Trending Stories
At Nariman House, a Jewish community centre, hostages were held by the attackers. What followed was a prolonged operation involving Mumbai Police, the Army, the Navy and the National Security Guard. For a city accustomed to moving at an extraordinary pace, the uncertainty of those hours was almost impossible to comprehend. Offices, hotels and public spaces became sites of emergency response. Families waited for information about relatives. Hospitals dealt with a continuous flow of injured people. The siege had turned an ordinary working week into a national crisis.
The people who became part of history
The story of 26/11 cannot be told only through the terrorists and the targets they selected. It must also be told through the people who confronted them. Mumbai Police officers were among the first to respond, often without the equipment and tactical resources required to deal with heavily armed attackers. The deaths of senior officers Hemant Karkare, Ashok Kamte and Vijay Salaskar underlined the risks faced by the police during the operation.
One of the most consequential moments came at Girgaum Chowpatty, where Assistant Sub-Inspector Tukaram Omble confronted Ajmal Kasab. Despite being fatally wounded, Omble managed to help overpower and capture Kasab alive. That capture would become critical to the investigation. For the first time, Indian investigators had a surviving attacker who could be questioned about the operation, its participants and its planning. The National Security Guard subsequently led the counterterror operation at the hotels and Nariman House. Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan was among the commandos killed during the operation. Hotel employees also displayed remarkable courage, helping guests escape and guiding people to safety while putting themselves in danger.
Beyond the security personnel, there were ordinary citizens whose lives were permanently altered. Among them was Devika Rotawan, a nine-year-old girl who was shot at CST. She later identified Kasab during the trial, becoming an important witness in the prosecution. Her experience represents a part of 26/11 that is sometimes lost in the discussion of security failures and military operations: the long aftermath experienced by those who survived. For survivors, the end of the operation did not mean the end of the attack. Injuries, trauma, loss and the memory of those hours continued long after the city returned to normal activity.
The questions that followed the siege
As the immediate crisis ended, attention shifted towards a more difficult question: how had ten terrorists managed to enter one of India’s largest cities and carry out coordinated attacks across multiple locations? The attacks exposed serious weaknesses in India’s coastal security arrangements, intelligence coordination and counterterror response.
Investigations and subsequent assessments examined intelligence inputs received before the attacks, including warnings about possible infiltration by sea and threats to prominent establishments.
A key concern was not simply whether information had reached the authorities, but whether it had been sufficiently evaluated, shared and acted upon. The official review of the attacks highlighted the difficulty of translating intelligence inputs into coordinated action. It also pointed to the challenges of assigning responsibility when information moved between multiple agencies.
The sea route became another major focus. The ease with which the attackers reached Mumbai exposed vulnerabilities in maritime surveillance and the monitoring of smaller vessels. The delay in bringing specialised counterterror units to Mumbai also became part of the wider examination of the country’s emergency response capabilities. The attacks exposed a difficult reality: having multiple security agencies does not automatically guarantee an effective response. Intelligence must reach the right people, information must be acted upon and agencies must be capable of coordinating under pressure.
What changed after 26/11?
The Mumbai attacks triggered a major overhaul of India’s counterterrorism framework. The National Investigation Agency was established in December 2008, creating a specialised central agency to investigate terrorism-related offences. Coastal security received renewed attention, with greater responsibilities assigned to the Indian Navy and Coast Guard and an expanded role for marine police forces. Surveillance systems and monitoring of maritime traffic were strengthened.
The Intelligence Bureau’s Multi Agency Centre was strengthened to improve information-sharing between central intelligence agencies, armed forces and state police. The National Security Guard expanded its regional presence through hubs in different parts of the country, reducing the need to depend entirely on its headquarters in Manesar for responding to emergencies in distant cities. Police modernisation and specialised counterterror training also received greater emphasis. These changes represented an important shift in how India approached internal security. The focus was no longer limited to responding after an attack. Prevention, intelligence coordination, coastal surveillance and rapid deployment became central to the discussion. However, security is not a static achievement.
Technology evolves, terrorist networks adapt and recruitment increasingly takes place through digital platforms. The recent Maharashtra ATS investigation into alleged reconnaissance of Chabad House and other sensitive locations in Mumbai has once again drawn attention to the possibility of threats targeting locations associated with the 2008 attacks. The investigation and allegations against the arrested individual will have to be established through due process. They do not, by themselves, indicate an imminent repeat of 26/11. But the case is a reminder that security agencies must remain alert to changing methods of surveillance, recruitment and coordination.
The pursuit of justice is not over
The legal and diplomatic consequences of 26/11 have continued well beyond the trial of Ajmal Kasab. Kasab was convicted and executed in November 2012. But investigators and prosecutors continued pursuing individuals accused of facilitating the attacks from outside India. One of the most significant developments came in April 2025, when the United States extradited Tahawwur Hussain Rana to India. Indian authorities accuse Rana of involvement in the conspiracy surrounding the attacks and of providing cover to David Coleman Headley, who conducted reconnaissance of Mumbai’s targets before the assault.
Rana has denied the allegations. His extradition nevertheless marked an important development in India’s long-running effort to pursue accountability beyond its borders. The case also underlined the international dimensions of 26/11. The attacks were carried out in Mumbai, but the investigation involved evidence, suspects and cooperation across multiple countries. For the families of those killed, the pursuit of justice remains inseparable from the memory of November 26.
Eighteen years later, what does Mumbai remember?
Mumbai has moved forward. Its railway stations remain crowded, its hotels are busy, its businesses continue to operate and its streets retain the energy that defines the city. The Taj has reopened. Chabad House continues its community activities. Memorials and annual commemorations ensure that the victims and heroes are not forgotten.
But the passage of time does not necessarily diminish the impact of a tragedy.
For families who lost loved ones, November 26 remains personal. For survivors, it is a reminder of the lives they had before that night and the lives they were forced to rebuild afterwards. For the security forces, it remains a defining chapter in India’s counterterrorism history. Eighteen years on, the most important question surrounding 26/11 is not simply how much has changed. It is whether the institutions responsible for protecting the country can recognise and respond to the next threat before it becomes another tragedy.
Remembering 26/11 cannot be reduced to an annual tribute or a replay of archival footage. It requires examining the failures, acknowledging the courage of those who fought back, listening to the survivors and continuing to ask difficult questions about preparedness and accountability. The gunfire stopped on November 29, 2008. Mumbai returned to work, and life gradually resumed. But the responsibility of ensuring that such an attack is never repeated did not end with the siege. Eighteen years later, 26/11 remains not just a memory of the night Mumbai was attacked, but a test of how much India has learnt from it.
